question: Should the repair lane adopt this stricter fail-closed authoritative-mutation contract on head 5951a7d0c384df6c0395a6ebd087e60d2e3023b0 after an exact-head canary?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes the safety and availability boundary for live repair closes and merges: stale or unprovable state now blocks rather than proceeding, and only maintainers can accept that operational tradeoff.

options.title: Canary then merge
options.body: Run one unchanged-state success canary plus stale-state rejection canaries on the exact head, then approve the stricter contract if receipts and deferred publication behave as designed.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Enable the new boundary first for one mutation phase or repository profile and expand after observing retry and blocked-outcome rates.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Decline the stricter fail-closed behavior and close or redesign the PR if the expected availability cost is unacceptable.

recommendation.title: Canary then merge
recommendation.body: Run one unchanged-state success canary plus stale-state rejection canaries on the exact head, then approve the stricter contract if receipts and deferred publication behave as designed.
